verdict_reason: One-sentence doc pointer to the new multi-select search guide; the link resolves, with one Minor wording ambiguity now that there are two shared type-aheads.

todos.issue: README.md:9 still calls the single-pick autocomplete 'The shared type-ahead', but this PR adds a second shared type-ahead (multi-select-search refreshes results as the trader types; the ticket titles it 'a search type-ahead'). A reader looking for the commodity type-ahead follows the first link to the wrong guide.
todos.fix: Must: each sentence names its component by what tells it apart, so neither is 'the' type-ahead. One way: 'The shared type-ahead for choosing one thing is documented in the accessible autocomplete guide. The shared search for choosing several things is documented in the multi-select search guide.'
